Body.Content:
What and why
Starting with Windows 11, version 24H2 and later, Windows settings backup and restore introduces restore summary. It’s a new on-device experience that helps users understand what was restored to their PC after setup. Users can view a summary of restored personalization settings and the Microsoft Store app list, having greater visibility into restore outcomes and getting productive faster on a new device.
 
Rollout schedule
Generally available with the October 2026 non-security update for Windows 11, version 24H2 or later.
 
Impact on your organization
Who is affected?
Organizations using Windows settings backup and restore can help users transition to new devices, recover from device replacement scenarios, or complete device refreshes.

What will happen?
With the new restore summary, users can gain immediate visibility into their restored experience after setup. This new capability helps accelerate time to productivity by making restore outcomes clear and easy to understand.
For more information about Windows settings backup and restore, see Windows settings backup and restore Overview.

Action required/recommendations
No action is required.

Organizations might want to:
  • Review the Windows settings backup and restore documentation to understand how backup and restore experiences work for their users.
  • Inform help desk and support teams that users will see a new restore summary experience following a successful restore process.

Compliance considerations
No compliance considerations are identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

Title: Introducing restore summary in Windows settings backup and restore
